as_told.title: Walker to Steinman: 'I was there. So what?' and known of MJ12 for 40 years

plain: This story is about a phone call between a UFO researcher, William (Bill) Steinman, and Eric Walker, who is described as a former president of Penn State, a university in the United States. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that another man, Robert Sarbacher, had described someone like Walker as being involved in secret UFO matters. Michels also says that when Steinman asked Walker directly about Majestic 12, said to be a secret group in charge of the subject, Walker replied that he had known about them for decades. A researcher, Grant Cameron, tells the call in more detail. He dates it to 1987 and says Walker answered, "I was there. So what?" and then, "I've known of them for 40 years. Leave it alone." Cameron says this convinced him that papers known as the MJ12 documents, said to describe the group, were the real deal. Michels's first telling also mentions talk of psychic abilities, while Cameron focuses on the admission. If true, it would mean a respected university leader confirmed a hidden government UFO group.
